pages.title: Hearth and Harvest
pages.text: $(bold)Three nodes on the Homesteader road:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/hh_orchard)Orchard and Trellis$(n), ring 3: crops, trellises and farm tools.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hh_hearth)Hearth$(n), ring 4: pies, cakes, sweets, cheese and its kitchen furniture.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hh_cellar)Cellar$(n), ring 5: casks, kegs, jams, pickles, juices and wine.

pages.title: Vaskar's Remains
pages.text: $(bold)The dead you find in the world can always be searched.$(br2)What they carry, their old weapons, staves, crowns and keepsakes, is yours to use once you own $(l:paths/relics)Relics of the Fallen$(n), ring 4 on the Ranger road.

pages.title: Vaskar's Bestiary
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)$(l:paths/beast_lore)Beast Lore$(n), ring 4: the hides, glands, scales and lair blocks of its creatures. Kill three trolls first.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/titans)Titans$(n), ring 8: the trophies of the Deep Mother, Ember Heart, Ice Colossus, Sand Maw and Trap Crown. Kill any one of them.

pages.title: Legionary
pages.text: $(bold)Kill the Unbreakable to open $(l:paths/unbreakable)The Unbreakable$(n), ring 6 on the Ranger road, for its cudgel, gold shards and the golden chains and lanterns.

pages.title: L_Ender's Cataclysm
pages.text: $(bold)Eight boss nodes on the Ranger road, one for each boss, each asking for its kill. The first road:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_end)The Ender Guardian$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_forge)The Netherite Monstrosity$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_fire)Ignis$(n), ring 11.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_void)The Harbinger$(n), ring 12.

pages.title: Cataclysm, Continued
pages.text: $(bold)The second road:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_desert)Ancient Remnant$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_deep)The Leviathan$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_cursed)Maledictus$(n), ring 11.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_storm)Scylla$(n), ring 12.$(br2)Each boss's lesser kin, such as the Kobolediator or the draugr, share their master's node.

pages.title: Born in Chaos
pages.text: $(bold)Two nodes on the Ranger road:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/chaos)Born in Chaos$(n), ring 5: dark metal, charms, elixirs and the blocks of its haunts. Kill 20 of its creatures first.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/chaos_lords)Lords of Chaos$(n), ring 8: the bosses' trophies. Kill any one of them.

pages.title: Hazen N Stuff
pages.text: $(bold)Three nodes on the Magician road:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/hazen_metals)Hazen's Metals$(n), ring 9: ores, ingots and its woods.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hazen_runes)Runes and Orbs$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hazen_arsenal)Flamebearer's Arsenal$(n), ring 11: every weapon and armour set. Kill one of the Flamebearer's officers first.

pages.title: Cult of Azazel
pages.text: $(bold)Kill the Divine Chariot Azazel to open $(l:paths/azazel)The Divine Chariot$(n), ring 10 on the Ranger road, for its scythe, spear, shield and armour. Its samsonit halls and keys are at $(l:paths/nether)Nether$(n). Azazel's kill is also the Evil Eye's task.

pages.title: Companions!
pages.text: $(bold)Kill the Sacred Pontiff or a Shade to open $(l:paths/saints_shades)Saints and Shades$(n), ring 9 on the Ranger road, for crystallised blood arms and armour and the holy robes. The companions themselves, their puppets and the Shade altars are at $(l:paths/husbandry)Husbandry$(n); the tesla machines at Redstone, the mage gear and spell books at Magician.
